user.title: Persona of the Day
user.description: Gives your voice assistant a new personality every day, picked from a catalog of 121 built-in personas (extendable with your own). Creates sensor.persona_of_the_day for use in your conversation agent's prompt. Ready to install?

abort.already_configured: Persona of the Day is already set up — there is only one persona per day.

init.title: Add personas
init.description: Paste new personas below, one per line. Get great ones by giving any AI chatbot the [persona generator prompt](https://github.com/TheSchultz/ha-persona-of-the-day/blob/main/PERSONA_GENERATOR.md). Entries are validated (max 120 characters, no brackets — rejections are explained in the system log) and duplicates are skipped automatically.
